title: Judge approves Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement with authors
summary: A federal judge approved the $1.5 billion class settlement over books pirated for Claude training, about $3,000 per work; Anthropic must destroy pirated copies.
reason: Compensation to creators from AI gains; known story reaching final approval.

title: Poll: 56% of US voters view AI favorably
summary: A HarrisX poll of 2,011 voters, commissioned by pro-AI group Build American AI, found 56% favorable and 53% backing rapid development.
reason: Survey showing acceptance; sponsor is an industry advocacy group.

title: Hugging Face turns to Chinese open model after US models refused to help analyze attack
summary: Hugging Face used Z.ai's GLM 5.2 to analyse the cyberattack on it after closed US frontier models refused, fuelling the open-weights debate.
reason: Shows open (Chinese) weights gaining ground versus closed labs.

title: Accenture wins up to $821M Pentagon contract for AI 'War Data Platform'
summary: Accenture Federal Services won a five-year contract to build software feeding 1,500+ military data streams into Pentagon AI tools; CDAO credited the platform in the Iran campaign. Exact date is a Monday in July; July 20 is best estimate.

title: Defense-AI funding surges: Shield AI raises $1.5B at $12.7B valuation
summary: Autonomous-drone maker Shield AI raised a $1.5B Series G; roundups counted over $3B in defense AI funding in July including Helsing's round. Date approximate (reported July 20).
reason: Autonomous weapons funding; date and figures from roundup only.
